plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Business Administration (Systemwide Transfer), Emphasis of Study, Associate in Science - 60 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25, Effective Date: 08/25; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-4 as printed. The map's header says 60 sh but its term totals print 15 / 15 / '16 or 17' / 15 (the Natural & Physical Science Requirement is printed as '4 or 5' sh); sequencing the minimum gives 61 sh, so total_credits = 61 with the science slot at its 4-sh minimum (same treatment as the non-transfer AS Business Administration map). Confirm the science selection with an advisor.

courses.title: Suggested emphasis elective
courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'Suggested Emphasis Elective', 3 sh from the list: ACCT 1602 General Accounting (3), BUSI 1602 Introduction to Leadership (3), BUSI 1607 Business Ethics (3), BUSI 1702 Supervisory Development (3), BUSI 1800 Business Communications (3), BUSI 1804 Human Relations in Business (3), BUSI 1807 Customer Service (3), ECON 1615 Personal Finance (3).

courses.title: Arts & humanities requirement
courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'Arts & Humanities Requirement', 3 sh (060). To meet the Arts & Humanities criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ARTS, COMM, DANC, ENGL, HIST, LITR, LANG, MUSI, PHIL, RELI, THEA).

courses.title: Natural & physical science requirement
courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'Natural & Physical Science Requirement' printed as '4 or 5' sh (040); sequenced at the 4-sh minimum so the plan totals 61.

courses.title: Accounting I
courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'ACCT 1614 or ACCT 1616 or ACCT 1610' (Accounting I / Accounting II / Financial Accounting), 3 sh.

courses.title: Principles of Management
